questionText: In a Star network topology, all client workstation nodes are connected directly to:

options.text: A single shared linear backbone coaxial bus cable
A central network hub, switch, or router
Each other in a closed unidirectional circular ring
Every single other node via dedicated point-to-point links (full mesh)

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
According to NCERT Class 12 Computer_Science (Computer Networks - Network Topologies: Star Topology):
In star topology, all devices are connected to a central device (hub/switch) via point-to-point cables. Failure of one cable affects only that node; failure of the central switch disables the entire network.

Hence, Option (B) is the correct answer.

(C) Power: power(x, n)
(D) Sum of List: list_sum(L)

List II:
(I) if n == 0 or n == 1: return 1

Choose the correct answer from the options given below:
detailedSolution:
